quotes.text: I thought you elves were supposed to be smart.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: The first of many burns

quotes.text: I thought you dwarfs were supposed to be short.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: The perfect clap-back

quotes.text: I do a backflip and land on my feet.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Nat 20 athletics after being thrown from the wagon

quotes.text: What a show.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: Watching Semaj's acrobatics

quotes.text: I won't do what you tell me!
quotes.speaker: GM (Alex)
quotes.context: Setting the Rage Against the Machine tone from the start

quotes.text: Stupid floor.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: His only thought after the rat battle

quotes.text: Am I the only one hanging on by a thread here?
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Realizing she almost died to rats

quotes.text: Bored him to death.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: After Ekran was knocked out by Borby

quotes.text: This is no time to be cooking.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Watching Periwinkle attack the dead boar

quotes.text: Think these things carry rabies?
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: Examining his wounds

quotes.text: I'm gonna be squishy but I can do cool looking things.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: After creating the fire wolf

quotes.text: Badass. Sleep Now with the Fire Wolf.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Naming the Rage Against the Machine song for Kaelia's fire wolf

quotes.text: I stare him down.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Facing the alpha wolf

quotes.text: It's not always about killing stuff.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: After the wolves retreated peacefully

quotes.text: How long have you been playing that? I guess just a few minutes.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: After his nat 20 pan flute performance

quotes.text: This soundtrack sounds like straight up Star Trek.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Breaking the fourth wall

quotes.text: Quite refreshing, the water's fine.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: After falling face-first into the stream

quotes.text: Sounds like he met his end.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: After Ekran shot a goblin in the rear

quotes.text: My arrow certainly did.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: Response to Semaj's pun

quotes.text: But it's fire and water.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Refusing to cross the stream

quotes.text: Anything to make everyone forget about the foot thing.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: After carrying Kaelia across

quotes.text: We should do Bulls on Parade with old school medieval instruments.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Suggesting the campaign's theme song

quotes.text: This wolf had it out for Klarg. Klarg must have tortured this wolf pretty hard.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: As the wolf delivers the killing blow

quotes.text: Retribution is the boy's name. That boy's name is Retribution.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: First naming the wolf (later became Larry)

quotes.text: That was a straight Han Solo and Chewie running right into the wall of Stormtroopers.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Describing Semaj's failed solo charge

quotes.text: Well, Semaj is able to live again. But, man, MVP ain't dog, ain't my buddy.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: End of session - the wolf was the real hero

quotes.text: I can keep you barely alive.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: On the party's healing capabilities

quotes.text: You made wolf paste.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: After Belden's hammer crit

quotes.text: That was a brutal duel. It was an upset victory—without the victory. It was just upset.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: After Belden lost the duel

quotes.text: That was so dramatic, clownish, and anti-climactic all at the same time.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Describing the duel

quotes.text: STOP! Fight me one-on-one!
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Challenging Yeemic to a duel

quotes.text: As a rogue, I'm not gonna honor any—now you lost a duel, like, I'mma shoot him in the face.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: Planning revenge after Belden fell

quotes.text: One of these other wolves I'll name him Gary. Gary and Ace.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Trying to name the other wolves

quotes.text: Belden, you got like Wil Wheaton level luck with those ones, man.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: After Belden's string of misses

quotes.text: COWARDS!
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Yeemic's dying word to Belden

quotes.text: If the Black Spider unlocks this cave before we do, gods help us all.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Revealing the stakes

quotes.text: Ruxithid is not a goblin. It's something older. Something patient. Something that waits.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: The mysterious whisper

quotes.text: Larry looks to Samaj with viscera and gore around his mouth like: Did I do a good job?
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: After Larry decapitates the snake

quotes.text: Frickin' Larry the GOAT.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: After Larry's snake kill

quotes.text: I should have, as the life was fading from his eyes, been like: Coward! COWARD!
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Belden's regret

quotes.text: Your hammer hits harder than you think. And your heart's even stronger. Don't forget that.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Ekran's farewell to Belden

quotes.text: Firelight doesn't just burn—it guides.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Ekran's farewell to Kaelia

quotes.text: To Ekran!
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Toast as Ekran departs

quotes.text: Joseph, you idiot.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Redbrands watching their friend trip down stairs

quotes.text: The last time this happened, I heard someone was eating dwarves and I failed my rage save. This time, I'm just drunk.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Explaining why he charged in

quotes.text: Let's gut these heroes and use their skulls for mugs!
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Redbrand battle cry before tripping

quotes.text: The drunken master for the win—he was dodging every dude and killing everybody.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Praising Belden's combat performance

quotes.text: I went into a big battle, killed a couple guys, and then went down in a blaze of glory. Woke up to dead bodies.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Summarizing his session

quotes.text: His brain just fizzles out and explodes and falls down.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Valrex's Toll the Dead

quotes.text: He lunges into the air, catches the Redbrand by the throat. And he just starts ripping.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Larry's kill

quotes.text: I was dealing with the personal turmoil of losing a duel with a goblin.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Explaining why he was drunk

quotes.text: Hammer smash face! It's a Cannibal Corpse song.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Describing Belden's attacks

quotes.text: I don't see a hippo.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Gaslighting Belden

quotes.text: Either I'm dead or I'm still drunk. What is going on?
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Confused by the Aster prank

quotes.text: You taste different. Magic in your blood. Pain in your past.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: The Nothic probing Semaj's mind

quotes.text: Grista mutters: I'm going to need to kill another pig.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: After Aster devoured breakfast

quotes.text: Let's remind these Redbrands what happens when good people stop standing alone.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Rallying the town

quotes.text: It's the ghost of hippo past!
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Belden trying to understand Aster

quotes.text: And by the time the flames finish, and you can see again in front of you, there is nothing. Absolutely nothing.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Belden's Dragon's Breath vaporizing an enemy

quotes.text: Today, you meet water.
quotes.speaker: Aster
quotes.context: Aster launching a water bullet

quotes.text: I'm just very unusually happy with the amount of fire going on in the general vicinity.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: After giving Belden Dragon's Breath

quotes.text: You cannot steal this from Shiva!
quotes.speaker: Aster
quotes.context: Complaining about Kaelia taking his kills

quotes.text: Both of these bugbears are now nearly disintegrated.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Semaj's bouncing Chromatic Orb

quotes.text: This was an entire session of combat. We didn't leave a room.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: End of session

quotes.text: I didn't use my hammer once at all. I fought the whole thing with traveler's clothes.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: After the cistern battle

quotes.text: The wet traveler's clothes is the last thing he sees.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Redbrand's death by rat-tail

quotes.text: The traveler's clothes whip—chef's kiss.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: End of session appreciation

quotes.text: This is the session I've decided that if there's a trap, I must test to see how well the trap is made.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Belden's new philosophy

quotes.text: I grab him by the throat, strangle him in one hand, and toss his dead body back in the cistern.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Undertaker-style kill

quotes.text: Shrapnel damage!
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Skeleton breastplate hitting another skeleton

quotes.text: He doesn't even scream. The fire just robs him of his breath before it robs him of his life.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Kaelia's killing blow on Glasstaff

quotes.text: He's double dead.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Confirming overkill on Glasstaff

quotes.text: When you started using teleport, I said NO.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: During the chase

quotes.text: This Phoenix Sorcerer is absolutely badass.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Praising Kaelia's build

quotes.text: He was supposed to protect Phandalin. Instead he terrorized it.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Realizing Iarno's betrayal

quotes.text: That was a well-earned kill. We went through 20 rounds.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Post-session appreciation

quotes.text: Those are the ones that killed the Redbrands.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Townsfolk recognizing the party

quotes.text: Bugbears hurt Droop. Droop was just stuck.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Droop's pathetic backstory

quotes.text: We killed him by the skin of his teeth.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Remembering Glasstaff's near-escape

quotes.text: That removes the knife at Phandalin's throat.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Hearing about Glasstaff's death

quotes.text: I rolled a natural one. I've never seen that before in my life.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Failing to recognize the Lion Shield symbol

quotes.text: Travelers don't usually wander into Thundertree by accident. State your business.
quotes.speaker: GM (Reidoth)
quotes.context: Reidoth answers the door

quotes.text: I'm rich. I'm rich!
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Pulling 90 gold out of a buried merchant's chest

quotes.text: Anyone who thinks they know more about this land because of their age is a fool.
quotes.speaker: GM (Reidoth)
quotes.context: Responding to Semaj claiming to be over 100 years old

quotes.text: Whatever Ruxithid is, it's patient. It doesn't try to seize you. It's watching. It's waiting.
quotes.speaker: GM
quotes.context: Semaj's Ruxithid meditation during the night watch

quotes.text: Let us go before she changes her mind.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: After Linene offered the discount deal at the Lion Shield Coster

quotes.text: It's a tree. It's just a bunch of twig blights all stacked on top of each other.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Realizing the 'tree' was actually more enemies

quotes.text: There are larger things than you out in the larger universe.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: To Reidoth, after the druid dismissed his claim of being over 100 years old

quotes.text: I really like things that are wood.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Activating Mantle of Flame against the twig blights

quotes.text: I figured adventurers enjoy killing rats.
quotes.speaker: GM (Patty)
quotes.context: Patty explaining why he didn't warn the party about his rat-infested storehouse.

quotes.text: I've got to say, pretty impressive jump. But you might need to work on the landing.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: After Belden jumped off crates, got his foot stuck in the floorboards, and dropped his warhammer — all in one turn.

quotes.text: It's hammer time.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Running full speed at the last boar before delivering the killing blow.

quotes.text: Rats, boars — with this luck we're gonna have to be dealing with reanimated bread in the bakery. Would that be the unbread?
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: Reflecting on the party's string of mundane-enemy encounters after waking from being knocked out by a boar.

quotes.text: I think that joke needs a little more time in the oven.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Responding to Ekran's unbread pun.

quotes.text: Farewell, bread wizard.
quotes.speaker: Ekran
quotes.context: Saying goodbye to Millhouse as the party left the bakery.

quotes.text: You look like crap.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: His chosen words when casting Healing Word on Kaelia after the rat battle.

quotes.text: I said I was proficient in perception. Not in staying awake.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: After repeatedly dozing off during his watch shift and jolting back awake — said quietly since everyone else was asleep.

quotes.text: You're either noble or stupid. But fine. No killing and no fire — just fists and steel.
quotes.speaker: GM (Yeemik)
quotes.context: Yeemik accepting Belden's challenge to a one-on-one duel in Cragmaw Cave.

quotes.text: Let's dance, dwarf.
quotes.speaker: GM (Yeemik)
quotes.context: Yeemik stepping to the center of the chamber to begin the duel.

quotes.text: Maybe he's eating someone. You remember that dwarf last week.
quotes.speaker: GM (goblin)
quotes.context: Goblins nervously speculating why Klarg hasn't checked in. The line enraged Belden and triggered his charge.

quotes.text: I ain't getting morning-starred.
quotes.speaker: GM (goblin)
quotes.context: Second goblin refusing to go tell Klarg about the escaped wolf.

quotes.text: By the gods — you came.
quotes.speaker: GM (Sildar)
quotes.context: Sildar's first words after the party unchained him in the goblin cave.

quotes.text: If this is how I die, smothered in wolf slobber.
quotes.speaker: GM (Sildar)
quotes.context: Larry enthusiastically licking Sildar's face after his rescue.

quotes.text: I feel better than I look now.
quotes.speaker: GM (Sildar)
quotes.context: After Kaelia cast Prestidigitation to clean the blood and grime off him.

quotes.text: A spider by any name is scary, but that's just me.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Responding to Kaelia's correction that the Black Spider probably isn't a literal spider.

quotes.text: No face, no race, no motive — just this web. And I got the feeling we've only seen the outer threads of it.
quotes.speaker: GM (Sildar)
quotes.context: Sildar describing everything he knows about the Black Spider.

quotes.text: You look like you come straight out of a goblin stew pot!
quotes.speaker: GM (Elmina)
quotes.context: Elmina's first sight of the battered party arriving at Barthen's Provisions.

quotes.text: Well, you ask real polite for a fellow traveling with a wolf.
quotes.speaker: GM (Tolben)
quotes.context: Semaj asking Tolben if Larry could have some raw meat.

quotes.text: Dad, did you say that was a wolf? He's so cool. It's like a person.
quotes.speaker: GM (Pip)
quotes.context: Tolben's young son spotting Larry at the bar.

quotes.text: He's dangerous. That's not a dog. That's a warrior's companion. He does have fluffy ears, though.
quotes.speaker: GM (Tolben)
quotes.context: Explaining Larry to his son Pip before letting him approach.

quotes.text: To new friends and dead goblins.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: First toast at the Stonehill Inn upon arriving in Phandalin.

quotes.text: I came with you all to make sure Sildar was safe. But somewhere along the way it became more than that.
quotes.speaker: GM (Ekren)
quotes.context: Ekren's farewell speech to the party before departing.

quotes.text: I think you see more than the rest of us combined. Watch their backs.
quotes.speaker: GM (Ekren)
quotes.context: Ekren's parting words to Semaj.

quotes.text: Well now, aren't you all dressed a bit brave for Phandalin?
quotes.speaker: GM (Redbrand)
quotes.context: First words from the Redbrand thugs outside the Sleeping Giant.

quotes.text: You die!
quotes.speaker: GM (Redbrand)
quotes.context: A Redbrand repeatedly stabbing the prone Valrex while he kept getting healed back to consciousness.

quotes.text: I flexed so hard that some of the wounds closed up.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: After using Second Wind mid-battle.

quotes.text: Direction is a social construct. Just like time.
quotes.speaker: Aster
quotes.context: After the party tried to explain which direction Tresendar Manor is.

quotes.text: You hit your head pretty hard. This is a figment of your imagination.
quotes.speaker: Aster
quotes.context: Gaslighting Belden about his own existence.

quotes.text: I was wondering when someone would stop asking for help and start calling for action.
quotes.speaker: GM (Darren Edermath)
quotes.context: Darren steps forward in the town square in response to Semaj's speech.

quotes.text: I'm ready to remember everything that's going to happen this time.
quotes.speaker: Belden
quotes.context: Rallying before entering the Redbrand hideout, after having been unconscious all last session.

quotes.text: Don't know why I'm surprised.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: After none of the other townsfolk would join the party's cause beyond Darren.

quotes.text: You've done a brave thing, young lad.
quotes.speaker: GM (Darren Edermath)
quotes.context: To the halfling boy who revealed the secret tunnel entrance.

quotes.text: Feel better, friend.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Healing Semaj after he was impaled by a bugbear's javelin.

quotes.text: I yanked it out.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: Pulling the bugbear's javelin from his own chest just before Valrex healed the wound.

quotes.text: ALRIGHT HUMANS, WE'RE UNDER ATTACK!
quotes.speaker: GM (Bugbear)
quotes.context: The last bugbear yelling down the corridor after seeing his allies nearly disintegrated.

quotes.text: You didn't hit anything, not once.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Taunting the bugbear who dropped his Morningstar mid-swing.

quotes.text: Aster is not the gif that keeps on giving.
quotes.speaker: Semaj
quotes.context: After Aster's musket missed multiple shots against the skeletons.

quotes.text: If you stop running, we can talk.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Kaelia tried a persuasion check to call out to Glasstaff mid-chase through the manor ruins. He did not acknowledge it.

quotes.text: I didn't think anyone would come, Darren.
quotes.speaker: GM (Myrna Dendrar)
quotes.context: Myrna's first words to Darren Edermath upon being found in the holding cells.

quotes.text: Droop goes to trees, hides, lives. You not like bugbears. You are nice to Droop.
quotes.speaker: GM (Droop)
quotes.context: Droop's farewell to the party before disappearing into the woods.

quotes.text: If your priority is speed, follow the directions the goblin gave you. If your priority is certainty, find Reidoth in Thundertree.
quotes.speaker: GM (Qelline Alderleaf)
quotes.context: Qelline clearly laying out the tactical choice facing the party before they depart Phandalin.

quotes.text: Least I can do. You cleared out ten Redbrand thugs in one night. That's more than this townmaster's done all year.
quotes.speaker: GM (Grista)
quotes.context: Grista explaining why she's giving the party free rooms.

quotes.text: You fight rough and loud and with more heart than sense. But you fight for something. That's more than I can say for the cultists or for the dragon.
quotes.speaker: GM (Reidoth)
quotes.context: Reidoth agreeing to join the party after Semaj's persuasion roll.

quotes.text: The little gnats bite.
quotes.speaker: GM (Venomfang)
quotes.context: Venomfang's reaction after Semaj hit him with a Lightning Chromatic Orb mid-flight.

quotes.text: The only person that didn't fight the dragon got downed.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: After being paralyzed, poisoned, and prone on the floor while the rest of the party slew a dragon.

quotes.text: At least I died old and not stupid.
quotes.speaker: GM (Reidoth)
quotes.context: Reidoth's reaction to Belden playing his horn at the entrance to the spider nest.

quotes.text: Don't go putting that foolishness on me. But as one more set of eyes and one more voice telling you when you're about to do something stupid. Like blowing that horn.
quotes.speaker: GM (Reidoth)
quotes.context: Reidoth laying out the terms of his participation after agreeing to join the party.

quotes.text: I want to find the maggot and slurp it up.
quotes.speaker: Aster
quotes.context: Immediately after Venomfang died from Crail's Maggot eating through his organs.

quotes.text: Hot water at least reminds us that we're alive.
quotes.speaker: GM (Reidoth)
quotes.context: Reidoth serving the party needle tea in his cottage.

quotes.text: I think it makes sense to try and kill him and not run him off, because if we run him off, he's just somebody else's problem.
quotes.speaker: Kaelia
quotes.context: Deciding the party's objective after Reidoth laid out the options for dealing with Venomfang.

quotes.text: I was listening to your narrative, but I was exploring.
quotes.speaker: Valrex
quotes.context: Explaining to the GM why he walked alone into the webbed building and triggered the spider fight.
